description: Domestic 10-K/10-KT acquisition queue over frozen FRAME_v1, admitting plain-text primaries (ADR-097). Same carrier, filters, shard size and per-accession allowance as domestic-primary-documents, so the shard membership is identical: 8,718 carrier rows over 8,526 unique accessions, 17,052 requests, 86 shards. It differs in one semantic — its planner emits primary_document_request_plan@0.3.0, so a shard may select a single .txt row when the form-matching rows contain no HTML, and admit it only if its bytes prove a standalone annual report. Because this definition hashes differently, its shard plans form a SEPARATE LINEAGE: artefacts produced under the v0.1 definition do not bind against these plans and the two are never mixed in one aggregate. Possessing this definition authorizes no request.

route_validation.note: URL-route grammar only, proven for the probe's own three accessions; never selection evidence for any firm in this queue.

deferred_cohorts.reason: Preserved by frozen FRAME_v1 and the carrier, and deliberately deferred: the acquisition form enum admits 10-K/10-KT only and FPI cover-page structure has never been measured here. Deferred, not excluded.
